errors.text_span: секторът "други услуги" е представен в синьо
errors.evidence: In the figure, 'Other services' is blue only in the legends? No: the color mapping shows Other services in dark blue, while Industry is yellow, Construction is light blue, and Trade is red; the machine text incorrectly swaps the category-to-color mapping by stating other services are blue in a generic way and then later assigns industry to brown, which does not match the legend.

The figure's legend shows Industry in yellow/gold, not brown. Brown/gold is used for Industry, but the machine description says 'promishlenost' is brown and elsewhere implies other-services is blue, conflicting with the actual legend mapping and making the color-category assignments unreliable.
The first donut chart ('NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES') shows Other services at 12%, not Industry. Industry is 61% (19.0 mln); 12% (3.7 mln) corresponds to Other services.
In the TURNOVER chart, 33% (10.6 tn) corresponds to Other services, not Industry. Industry is 31% (9.8 tn).

errors.text_span: Секторът "търговия" е в червено и заема 19% от броя предприятия, 19% от броя заети лица и 31% от оборота.
errors.evidence: Trade is red, but in the first chart Trade is 19% indeed and in the second chart Trade is 19%, while in the turnover chart Trade is 31%; however the machine description's broader mapping is wrong because it earlier assigns 'other services' as blue and 'industry' as brown, so the category-color assignments are inconsistent with the legend.

The description does not mention that the figure consists of three donut/pie charts with no conventional axes, nor does it clearly state the chart title/subtitle as shown in the image, though this is partly covered by the opening sentence.

errors.text_span: Секторът "строителство" е в жълто и представлява 8% от броя предприятия, 21% от броя заети лица и 6% от оборота.
errors.evidence: This sentence is readable, but combined with the rest of the description it uses a mixed and contradictory color mapping; the category 'строителство' is actually light blue in the legend, not yellow, making the statement ambiguous/misleading.

errors.text_span: За всяка категория, секторът "други услуги" е представен в синьо и заема най-голям дял, съответно 61% от броя предприятия, 51% от броя заети лица и 31% от оборота.
errors.evidence: The sentence is awkward because it suggests a single sector is the largest in all three charts, but the third chart has 'Other services' at 33%, while Industry and Trade are both 31%; the phrasing overstates the visual relationship.
